title: PGGMB Building
geometryBasis: Named five-node OpenStreetMap way 314217096 provides the main external outline and 17 storeys at Jalan Kianggeh. The Brunei Malay Teachers Association independently identifies the address and 17-storey replacement.
sectionBasis: The 14 May 2002 official opening confirms continuity of site with the 26 February 1965 original. Mixed floor usage establishes broad retail podium, mid-level parking, and upper office and meeting functions. The modeled exterior articulation and height are estimates.
limitations: Present 17-storey replacement only. It opened on the same site as the 1965 teachers’ building.
The lower envelope follows the exact native outline. The upper footprint, setbacks, roof height, entry, cladding, glazing and window rhythms are architectural estimates.
The 1965 photograph has no accepted public-domain evidence for this source. The current Qualla exterior requires attribution. Model uses written facts and original terrain.
